dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: It's a name... the name of my tool.

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: "Steadfast" describes its tenacity, "Berserker" praises its strength, and "Strongest" reflects my utmost faith in its abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: Names are important vessels of symbolism in Natlan, so my most trusted tool deserves a most glorious name of its own.
